evals.name: fixture-two-owners
evals.prompt: I have a small git repo at /tmp/find-reviewers-fixture. My branch `feat/billing-refund` (base `main`) adds partial refunds and a refunded status on invoices — it touches billing/refunds.py and billing/invoices.py. Who are the best people to review this PR? Recommend 2-3 reviewers in priority order with the evidence behind each pick. Treat the repo as read-only — don't modify anything in it.
evals.expected_output: Recommends Bob Marsh first (owns billing/refunds.py: 8 commits, 4 recent) and Alice Zhang second (owns billing/invoices.py: 5 commits once her two identities are merged), excludes Carol Reyes (PR author), with commit-count evidence and an explicit review order.

assertions.text: Does not recommend Carol Reyes as a reviewer
Merges Alice's two identities (alice@acme.io + alice.zhang@gmail.com) or cites her true total of ~5 commits on invoices.py
Gives a review order and evidence (commit counts), not just names

evals.name: panel-review-small-repo
evals.prompt: In the repo /Users/krishnan@aaru.com/Code/krishnan-pi-extensions I'm planning a change to the panel-review extension (extensions/panel-review/). Who should review that PR? Keep it read-only.
evals.expected_output: Identifies Krishnan Chandra as the sole builder of panel-review (3 commits, two merged identities), and is honest that a single-contributor repo has weak reviewer signals — suggests the author's own nominations / external or pair review rather than inventing candidates.

assertions.text: Names Krishnan Chandra as the extension's builder
Is honest about the weak-signal situation (single contributor / author would review own work) instead of inventing reviewers
Does not fabricate reviewers who never touched the repo
